# New England Video Depositions

New England Video Depositions provides professional video recording services for both in-person and remote legal depositions across New England and nationwide, backed by hundreds of successful recordings and a Certified Legal Video Specialist. Founded in 2019 and trusted by law firms and court reporting agencies, the company distinguishes itself through dependable service, high-quality audio-visual production that meets legal standards, and rapid 24-hour delivery turnaround. Their comprehensive offerings include technical pre-deposition assistance, backup recording systems, professional screen-capturing software, and coordination with partner court reporters to ensure seamless, precision-focused legal proceedings.
